headline: Base Exchanges Subside Across Fronts as Heavy Attrition Consumes Northern Hexes
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the frantic wave of base captures has halted entirely across the map, with no strategic installations changing hands over the past two hours. The island sectors of Godcrofts and Fisherman's Row have cooled into quiet territory following earlier Colonial sweeps that solidified full control over both archipelagos. In contrast, severe attrition persists along contested northern and central battlegrounds. Weathered Expanse remains a focal point of intense carnage, claiming over sixteen hundred casualties in the last two hours despite base perimeters holding steady. Stonecradle exhibits sharply accelerating combat with over a thousand combined losses and brisk enlistment traffic along its divided front. Callahan's Passage likewise sustains punishing firefights, logging more than twelve hundred casualties in two hours, while clashes persist in Mooring County following the Colonial seizure of The Wind Hills. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy and Stlican Shelf have seen combat volumes taper noticeably after prior upheavals, leaving the rear logistics hexes completely undisturbed.
